description: After inaugurating the centralised farmers' call centre here, Cheluvarayaswamy said that the AI-based super app will be able to predict and provide information on weather and soil quality.
body_lead: Karnataka government to launch AI-based app for farmers After inaugurating the centralised farmers' call centre here, Cheluvarayaswamy said that the AI-based super app will be able to predict and provide information on weather and soil quality. Representative image of a farmer.
